bulletin.night: Conditions are favourable for further withdrawal from remaining parts of Punjab, Haryana Chandigarh Delhi, some more parts of Rajasthan and some parts of Saurashtra & Kutch, Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand and West Uttar Pradesh during next 2 days.

met_analysis:
Conditions are favourable for further withdrawal from remaining parts of Punjab, Haryana-Chandigarh-Delhi, some more parts of Rajasthan and some parts of Saurashtra & Kutch, Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand and West Uttar Pradesh during next 2 days.
The Depression over Westcentral & adjoining Northwest Bay of Bengal, moved west-northwestwards with speed 07 kmph during past 06 hours, intensified into a deep Depression and lies centered at 1730 hrs IST of today, the 22nd September, 2026, over the same region near latitude 18.0°N and longitude 85.4°E, about 140 km east-southeast of Kalingapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), 150 km south-southeast of Gopalpur (Odisha), 210 km south-southwest of Puri (Odisha), and 220 km east of Visakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh). Continuing to move west-northwestwards it is very likely to cross north Andhra Pradesh - South Odisha coasts between Visakhapatnam & Gopalpur as a Deep Depression by night of 23rd September 2026.
The trough from centre of the Deep Depression over Westcentral & adjoining Northwest Bay of Bengal to southeast Arabian sea across Coastal Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka between 3.1 &7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle level tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 78°E to the north of Lat. 29°N.
